description_expanded: OverviewPool Front at High Pointe Resort - Ground Floor Unit - `Beach Blessing`The Space Luxury Pool-Front Getaway | High Pointe Beach Resort #122 QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Breathtaking Views – Wake up to stunning coastal scenery 6,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool w/ Waterfalls – Resort-style relaxation Kiddie Pool & Heated Spa Pool – Fun for the whole family! Pickleball & Tennis Courts – Get active & enjoy the sunshine Fenced Playground & Shuffleboard – Perfect for kids & leisure play Outdoor BBQ Grills Throughout Resort – Grill & dine al fresco Crabby Steve’s Beachfront Bar & Grill – Oceanfront dining at its best Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your getaway General Parking with Passes Included Gated Gulf-Front Resort – Private & secure beach experience Professionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceWelcome to Beach BlessingThis 2-bedroom condo in High Pointe Beach Resort (#122) offers everything you could want in a vacation rental. Large glass windows offer a dazzling view of High Pointe Beach Resort’s resort-style waterfall pool. Enjoy your morning coffee or evening wine on the pool-front patio while watching the kids play outdoors. Flat-screen TVs, stereo, and plenty of seating for family and friends mean that everyone will be well-entertained and comfortable.The resort offers free parking. There's a casual tiki bar and grill. Additional amenities include an outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus shuffleboard courts, tennis courts, a playground and a BBQ area. High Pointe Resort is in a gated Gulf Front Resort located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches in Seacrest Beach on the south side of Scenic 30A. High Pointe Resort is the most well-known and well thought of Gulf Front Beach Resort property on 30A.Two composite tennis courts, shuffle board courts, barbecue grills located throughout the property and the children will enjoy the play area made just for them. In addition to the huge, 6,000 square foot lagoon pool, there is a baby/child pool and a large hot tub.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** Golf Carts are not allowed in this community.**** Please note that guests are not allow visitors in this community**** Please note there will be construction at the property and the balcony will be unavailable until Memorial Day 2025**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6):Master - King bedGuest Room - 2 full sized bedsAREA ATTRACTIONS:High Pointe Resort is a 5 min stroll (2 blocks) from Rosemary Beach's village, restaurants and shops. The 30A Bike path runs right through the front of the property and meanders along the entire 18 miles of Scenic 30A.Show less
